title: PersonaMix Solo #41 (솔로 · 호박 · 호박 꿀색 · 앵글 하이앵글 70도 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Japanese · 메이크업 푸시아 립 극한 · 배경 라벤더 들판(화창한 낮) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight golden blonde hair — full body polished honey amber resin fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid amber resin curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted amber sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING warm honey-orange amber surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deeper red-brown swirls and tiny golden bubbles flowing through every section, with mother-of-pearl flowers inlaid into the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning against a pillar with one arm resting on it, one knee bent — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same amber, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same amber with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT amber — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: electric saturated hot-pink-red lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, bold pink-fuchsia eyeshadow, dramatic lashes, a deep flushed blush.

Background: a blooming lavender field in neat rows under a clear sky with a gravel path, a wooden gate and fence of normal height, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length steep high-angle shot taken from far above with a long telephoto lens, the camera directly above and in front of her angled roughly seventy degrees downward as if from a high ceiling or drone, flat telephoto compression with natural proportions and no wide-angle distortion, the whole figure from head to boots fully visible, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
